reason: A is more physically credible because aluminizing supplies the Al needed to form a protective Al2O3 scale, whereas B extrapolates a fluorine-induced alumina mechanism from Al-rich TiAl to Al-free HfNbTaTiZr and offers no sound basis for a protective Hf/Nb/Ta oxide. A remains under-specified quantitatively and must test for brittle aluminide-layer effects, but it is the stronger proposal to pursue.
